`astronaut.png` is the NASA public-domain portrait of astronaut Eileen Collins, mirrored without modification from scikit-image v0.19.3:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.19.3/skimage/data/astronaut.png

Source and public-domain status: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Used only as a fictional camera input in browser segmentation tests, never as a Talk avatar or production background. NASA does not endorse Talk.
